subject.title: fix: harden cloud worker admission and remote turns

question: Has Crabbox 0.38.1+ been published and verified through the supported installation channels so this fail-closed OpenClaw change can land without disabling existing AWS cloud workers?
rationale: The code-level review cannot decide when the external runtime release is operationally available or whether maintainers intentionally accept an immediate compatibility outage for operators still receiving Crabbox 0.38.0.

options.title: Publish, verify, then merge
options.body: Release Crabbox 0.38.1+, verify the installed binary's inspect contract, refresh this branch onto current main, and merge after exact-head proof passes.

options.title: Accept an AWS worker outage
options.body: Merge before the dependency release only if maintainers explicitly accept that current Crabbox 0.38.0 AWS profiles will fail closed until operators upgrade.

options.title: Pause the OpenClaw landing
options.body: Keep the PR open without merging if the Crabbox release or supported-channel rollout cannot be completed safely.

recommendation.title: Publish, verify, then merge
recommendation.body: Release Crabbox 0.38.1+, verify the installed binary's inspect contract, refresh this branch onto current main, and merge after exact-head proof passes.

likelyOwner.reason: The cloud-worker feature, companion Crabbox release, and OpenClaw landing are coordinated through this owner in the available history and discussion.
